crossRefs.note: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of…
There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.
translations.bsb: This was the field that Abraham had bought from the Hittites. Abraham was buried there with his wife Sarah.
translations.kjv: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
translations.asv: The field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth. There was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
